events.title: Simon de Montfort is killed at the Battle of Evesham
events.description: The future Edward I defeated and killed Simon de Montfort at Evesham, ending the barons' rebellion against Henry III. Montfort's parliaments with elected burgesses outlived him.
events.html: The future Edward I defeated and killed Simon de Montfort at Evesham, ending the barons' rebellion against Henry III. Montfort's parliaments with elected burgesses outlived him.

events.title: The Black Parliament tries plotters against Robert the Bruce
events.description: A specially convened parliament at Scone tried William II de Soules, Lord of Liddesdale, and others who had conspired against King Robert I. Soules confessed his treason and was sentenced to life imprisonment; his fellow conspirators were executed.

events.title: Edward the Black Prince launches a large-scale mounted raid
events.description: An Anglo-Gascon force under Edward the Black Prince began a large-scale chevauchée, or mounted raid, that lasted until 2 October. In the same year the prince captured King John II of France at Poitiers.
events.html: An Anglo-Gascon force under Edward the Black Prince began a large-scale chevauchée, or mounted raid, that lasted until 2 October. In the same year the prince captured King John II of France at Poitiers.

events.title: Moroccan forces destroy King Sebastian's army at Alcácer Quibir
events.description: Near Ksar-el-Kebir, Moroccan forces destroyed the Portuguese army of King Sebastian, who was killed with much of the nobility. Sebastian's death without an heir led to the union of the Portuguese and Spanish crowns in 1580.
events.html: Near Ksar-el-Kebir, Moroccan forces destroyed the Portuguese army of King Sebastian, who was killed with much of the nobility. Sebastian's death without an heir led to the union of the Portuguese and Spanish crowns in 1580.

events.title: Anglo-Dutch forces capture Gibraltar
events.description: A fleet under Admiral Sir George Rooke took Gibraltar during the War of the Spanish Succession. Ceded to Britain in 1713, it remains a British territory despite repeated Spanish claims.
events.html: A fleet under Admiral Sir George Rooke took Gibraltar during the War of the Spanish Succession. Ceded to Britain in 1713, it remains a British territory despite repeated Spanish claims.

events.title: France's National Assembly abolishes feudal privileges
events.description: In a night session, nobles and clergy renounced their seigneurial rights, tithes and exemptions one after another. The decrees swept away much of the legal framework of the Ancien Régime.
events.html: In a night session, nobles and clergy renounced their seigneurial rights, tithes and exemptions one after another. The decrees swept away much of the legal framework of the Ancien Régime.

events.title: Britain declares war on Germany
events.description: When Germany ignored an ultimatum to respect Belgian neutrality, Britain declared war at 11 pm London time. The British Empire's entry turned a continental war into a global one.
events.html: When Germany ignored an ultimatum to respect Belgian neutrality, Britain declared war at 11 pm London time. The British Empire's entry turned a continental war into a global one.

events.title: Anne Frank and her family are arrested in Amsterdam
events.description: German police raided the secret annexe at Prinsengracht 263, arresting the Frank family and four others. Anne died in Bergen-Belsen in early 1945; her diary became a classic of Holocaust testimony.
events.html: German police raided the secret annexe at Prinsengracht 263, arresting the Frank family and four others. Anne died in Bergen-Belsen in early 1945; her diary became a classic of Holocaust testimony.

events.title: US destroyers report a second attack in the Gulf of Tonkin
events.description: US warships reported an attack by North Vietnamese boats that probably never happened. Within days Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution, authorising Johnson to escalate the Vietnam War.
events.html: US warships reported an attack by North Vietnamese boats that probably never happened. Within days Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution, authorising Johnson to escalate the Vietnam War.
